name: hexo
description: Command line interface for Hexo, a static site generator

options.description: Uses a custom config file (instead of `_config.yml`). Also accepts a comma-sepa…

options.name: --safe
options.description: Disable loading plugins and scripts

options.name: --debug
options.description: Log verbose messages to the terminal and to `debug.log`

options.name: --silent
options.description: Silence output to the terminal

options.name: --draft
options.description: Display draft posts (stored in the `source/_drafts` folder)

options.name: --cwd
options.description: Customize the path of current working directory

subcommands.name: help
subcommands.description: Displays a help for each command

options.name: --no-clone
options.description: Copy files instead of cloning from GitHub

options.name: --no-install
options.description: Skip npm install

name: -p
--path
options.description: Post path. Customize the path of the post

name: -r
--replace
options.description: Replace the current post if it existed

name: -s
--slug
options.description: Post slug. Customize the URL of the post

name: -d
--deploy
options.description: Deploy after generation finishes

name: -f
--force
options.description: Force regenerate

name: -w
--watch
options.description: Watch file changes

name: -b
--bail
options.description: Raise an error if any unhandled exception is thrown during generation

name: -c
--concurrency
options.description: Maximum number of files to be generated in parallel. Default is infinity

subcommands.description: Start a local server. By default, this is at http://localhost:4000/

name: -i
--ip
options.description: Override the default server IP. Bind to all IP address by default

name: -p
--port
options.description: Override default port

name: -s
--static
options.description: Serve static files from the given directory

name: -l
--log
options.description: Enable logger. Override logger format

name: -o
--open
options.description: Immediately open the server url in your default web browser

options.name: --setup
options.description: Setup without deployment

name: -g
--generate
options.description: Generate static files before deploying

options.description: Prettify JSON output

subcommands.description: Migrate content from other blog systems
